tools.description: Sniper-mode Stochastic Fractal Search: the K nearest rows of a corpus to a query, minimizing cosine distance. Give corpus_key (a stored corpus: rows packed as float32 in one key, see fractal_store_vectors) OR corpus (an inline array of rows). Returns best_point, best_fit and top_k as [{idx, dist}].
tools.name: fractal_search

tools.description: Scout-mode SFS: the whole converged population (every particle's position and fitness) rather than only the top K, for clustering and diversity analysis. Same corpus_key / corpus choice as fractal_search.
tools.name: fractal_search_explore

tools.description: Build the native IVF index of a corpus key: a k-means partition with INT8, INT4, FP16 or FP32 codes. The build writes ordinary string keys beside the corpus (one per cell, a metadata key and a generation pointer), so they persist and replicate like any other key. Needs the dimension of the corpus.
tools.name: fractal_index_create

tools.description: Rebuild an index from the current corpus: a new generation is written and the pointer is flipped, so a reader only ever sees a complete generation.
tools.name: fractal_index_rebuild

tools.description: Drop an index: the cells, the metadata and the generation pointer are removed.
tools.name: fractal_index_drop

tools.description: Describe an index: its status (ready, stale, degraded, empty or orphaned) with advice on what to do next (refresh or rebuild), its format and sizes, the rows added since the build, the calibration and the statistics of the last search (the rows the index scanned).
tools.name: fractal_index_info

tools.description: The corpus positions a Scout pass should look at: the rows of the nearest cells of an index, nearest first, plus the rows added after the build. A shortlist, not an answer: the distances are not computed here.
tools.name: fractal_index_candidates

tools.description: List the indexes of a corpus key, each with its format, dimension, rows indexed, rows now, status (ready, stale, degraded, empty or orphaned) and generation.
tools.name: fractal_index_list

tools.description: Fold the rows appended to a corpus since the build into the index's cells, without retraining: a new generation is written and the pointer is flipped. Rewritten or removed rows need fractal_index_rebuild; fractal_index_info says which one it advises.
tools.name: fractal_index_refresh

tools.description: Bring an index up to date with the least work and say what was done: create it when it does not exist, refresh it when up to a quarter of its rows were appended since the build, rebuild it when more were added or rows were rewritten or removed, and leave it alone when it is current. The reply names the action (created, refreshed, rebuilt or unchanged), the status, the generation and the rows.
tools.name: fractal_index_ensure

tools.description: Start (or reset) a diversify session: later searches given the same session avoid the neighbourhoods it has been told to reject.
tools.name: fractal_diversify_enable

tools.description: Turn diversification off for a session (the session and its history stay).
tools.name: fractal_diversify_disable

tools.description: Read a session's diversify parameters, or set some of them with a JSON object (window_n, stall_threshold, repulsion_sigma, repulsion_weight, max_shadows_considered, tail_buffer_cap).
tools.name: fractal_diversify_params

tools.description: Why the last search through a session looked the way it did: D_q, whether diversify is on, and overhead.
tools.name: fractal_explain_result

tools.description: Tell a session how a result was received so later searches steer away from rejected rows.
tools.name: fractal_feedback_report

tools.description: Mark one result as background noise for a session so it is excluded from future repulsion.
tools.name: fractal_isolate_background

tools.description: Drop a diversify session and free its memory.
tools.name: fractal_session_close

tools.description: List the live diversify sessions.
tools.name: fractal_session_list

tools.description: Send a question (and optional JSON context) to the configured reasoning model through the fractalsqld daemon. Needs a daemon with a model; otherwise a clean 'not configured' error.
tools.name: fractal_reason

tools.description: Embed text with the configured embedding model through the fractalsqld daemon; returns the vector.
tools.name: fractal_embed

tools.description: Drift on one entity's metric series, then a model-written triage summary. Returns threat_score, anomaly_type and triage_summary (or the computed half plus reasoning_step_failed when no model answers).
tools.name: fractal_agent_anomaly_triage

tools.description: Cardinality-constrained portfolio optimisation, then a written rationale. Returns the allocation and its Sharpe ratio.
tools.name: fractal_agent_allocate

tools.description: Route a task to the nearest capability under a token budget, with a written justification.
tools.name: fractal_agent_route_task

tools.description: Intercept a proposed state that is too close to a known-bad one. Returns intercepted, the nearest distance and a reason.
tools.name: fractal_agent_outlier_intercept

tools.description: Pure retrieval, no model: the K nearest memories to a query, optionally restricted to a cohort.
tools.name: fractal_agent_recall_hybrid

tools.description: Pure retrieval, no model: K recommendations that are relevant and mutually diverse.
tools.name: fractal_agent_recommend_diverse

tools.description: Natural-language question over hashes: the model writes a filter, the module validates and runs it under YOUR ACL, and the model analyses the rows. Uses a valkey-search index when it is loaded, otherwise scans the keys under a prefix. Needs a model.
tools.name: fractal_agent_data_analyst

tools.description: Cohort search plus the drift from baseline to current, then a written triage. Returns cohort_matches, a projected trajectory and a summary.
tools.name: fractal_agent_patient_deterioration_triage

tools.description: Self-contained diversify health check: warm a session with the first rows of a corpus, search, and report the diversity quotient. No model.
tools.name: fractal_agent_feedback_audit

tools.description: Place a workload on the nearest node by capability vector, with a written justification and confidence.
tools.name: fractal_agent_schedule_workload

tools.description: Optimise a portfolio, find the most similar past allocation by weight change, and explain the rebalance.
tools.name: fractal_agent_rebalance_sibling

tools.description: Classify a vehicle's detour: nearest fleet peer by route change and the box-counting complexity of its GPS trace, with a written verdict.
tools.name: fractal_agent_detour_classify

tools.description: Track deviation check: nearest peer plus the DFA exponent of the heading series, with a written assessment.
tools.name: fractal_agent_track_anomaly

tools.description: Sensor-grid coverage: morphological dimension and lacunarity of the point cloud plus drift in the telemetry, then an alert.
tools.name: fractal_agent_network_coverage_alert

tools.description: General-purpose regime check on any series: DFA exponent and drift, then a written triage.
tools.name: fractal_agent_regime_triage

tools.description: Enterprise: several mutually different near-optimal portfolios (sharpe) or the return-versus-risk front (pareto), with a written comparison.
tools.name: fractal_agent_diverse_portfolios

tools.description: Embed a seed state and branch it into the nearest strategies. Needs an embedding provider.
tools.name: fractal_agent_plan_explore

tools.description: Project the next state from a time-ordered state log: the drift since a baseline row, applied to the current state. No model.
tools.name: fractal_agent_trajectory_predict

tools.description: Detect an agent stuck in a loop: fingerprint each logged state and find a cycle, tolerating a few differing bits. No model.
tools.name: fractal_agent_detect_loop

tools.description: Embed a question, search the corpus, and answer from the hits. Needs an embedding provider and a model.
tools.name: fractal_search_agent

tools.description: Retrieval-augmented answer: search_agent with a fixed search. Returns the answer, source_row_ids (the rows' ids: the IDS hash values when given, else the row indexes) and timing.
tools.name: fractal_rag_agent

tools.description: The table-free CONVERGENCE function: Stochastic Fractal Search toward the query direction, answering {dim, population_size, best_point, best_fit}. It reads no key and is not a retrieval command (the indexed search is fractal_search with an index).
tools.name: fractal_sfs_converge

tools.description: Detrended fluctuation analysis exponent of a series: about 0.5 for noise, above 1 for persistent trends.
tools.name: fractal_dimension_dfa

tools.description: Regime drift: the DFA exponent of the recent window against the baseline before it.
tools.name: fractal_dimension_drift

tools.description: Box-counting fractal dimension of a point cloud.
tools.name: fractal_dimension_boxcount

tools.description: Dominant frequencies of a series: the strongest spectral peaks.
tools.name: fractal_periodogram

tools.description: Split text into chunks of at most chunk_size characters (code points): a JSON array of {no, start, end, text}; start and end are character offsets, end exclusive. chunk_mode paragraph (default) packs whole paragraphs, sentence packs whole sentences, fixed cuts every chunk_size - chunk_overlap characters; a paragraph or sentence longer than chunk_size is cut with chunk_overlap shared. Pure: no model, the same output on every FractalSQL host.
tools.name: fractal_chunk_text

tools.description: Indices where the series' behaviour changes.
tools.name: fractal_change_point_detect

tools.description: A compact bit fingerprint of a vector (random-hyperplane hash); returns hex bytes.
tools.name: fractal_state_fingerprint

tools.description: Spectral entropy per sliding frame: low for tonal signals, near 1 for noise.
tools.name: fractal_spectrogram_entropy

tools.description: Find a cycle in a stream of fingerprints (Brent's algorithm), tolerating a few differing bits.
tools.name: fractal_cycle_detect

tools.description: Persistent homology of a point cloud: H0 and H1 barcodes.
tools.name: fractal_tda_persistence_diagram

tools.description: Fractal dimension and lacunarity of a point cloud.
tools.name: fractal_morphological_complexity

tools.description: Gyrification index of a mesh: surface area against its convex hull.
tools.name: fractal_cortical_folding

tools.description: Fibre-length density and branch density of a nerve skeleton.
tools.name: fractal_nerve_plexus_metric

tools.description: Tortuosity, branch density and fractal dimension of a vessel tree.
tools.name: fractal_vascular_network

tools.description: Cardinality-constrained Sharpe maximisation by Stochastic Fractal Search.
tools.name: fractal_optimize_portfolio

tools.description: Value-weighted k-subset allocation: maximise sum(weight x item_value) with at most k items weighted, each weight at most its upper bound, the weights summing to 1. prev_weights and turnover_penalty steer the search away from reallocating (rebalancing). Answers {score, weights}.
tools.name: fractal_optimize_subset

tools.description: Upserts a feature vector against a doc_id in a hash key (the generic per-item feature store); the last write wins. Returns OK.
tools.name: fractal_store_morphology

tools.description: Brute-force k-NN (true Euclidean, ascending) over the feature store hash. Returns [{'doc_id','distance'}], nearest first. A stored vector of another dimension is skipped, not an error.
tools.name: fractal_mine_topology_negatives

tools.description: Parses a vector from text -- a JSON array, or a comma-separated list of numbers -- into the canonical vector.
tools.name: fractal_vector_from_text

tools.description: Renders a vector as JSON: the array of numbers, so a client can see exactly what the engine holds.
tools.name: fractal_vector_to_json

tools.description: The vector's L2 norm (its magnitude).
tools.name: fractal_vector_norm

tools.description: The vector scaled to unit length, so a distance between two vectors reflects direction only.
tools.name: fractal_vector_normalize

tools.description: The element-wise sum of two vectors.
tools.name: fractal_vector_add

tools.description: The element-wise difference of two vectors.
tools.name: fractal_vector_sub

tools.description: The vector multiplied by a scalar factor.
tools.name: fractal_vector_scale

tools.description: The L2 (Euclidean) distance between two vectors.
tools.name: fractal_vector_l2_distance

tools.description: The squared L2 distance: the same measure without the square root.
tools.name: fractal_vector_l2_squared

tools.description: The cosine distance between two vectors: 0 when they point the same way, 1 when they are orthogonal.
tools.name: fractal_vector_cosine_distance

tools.description: The cosine similarity between two vectors: 1 when they point the same way, 0 when they are orthogonal.
tools.name: fractal_vector_cosine_similarity

tools.description: Minkowski L_p distance.
tools.name: fractal_vector_lp_distance

tools.description: Differing bits between two equal-length binary strings (hex).
tools.name: fractal_vector_hamming_distance

tools.description: Scalar int8 quantisation: returns scale and codes (4x smaller).
tools.name: fractal_vector_quantize_int8

tools.description: Sign-bit quantisation: one bit per dimension, as hex bytes.
tools.name: fractal_vector_quantize_binary

tools.description: Walk a ledger chain and report whether it is intact (ok, rows_verified, or the first failure). Needs the daemon.
tools.name: fractal_ledger_verify

tools.description: Entries in the truth ledger. Needs the enterprise tier.
tools.name: fractal_ledger_truth_count

tools.description: Entries in the shadow ledger. Needs the enterprise tier.
tools.name: fractal_ledger_shadow_count

tools.description: Persist the ledger to its file. Needs the enterprise tier.
tools.name: fractal_ledger_flush

tools.description: Load the persisted ledger into memory. Needs the enterprise tier.
tools.name: fractal_ledger_load

tools.description: Compact the ledger. Needs the enterprise tier.
tools.name: fractal_ledger_compact

tools.description: Clear the in-memory shadow state, keeping the truth ledger. Needs the enterprise tier.
tools.name: fractal_ledger_reset_soft

tools.description: Erase the ledger entirely. Irreversible. Needs the enterprise tier.
tools.name: fractal_ledger_reset_hard

tools.description: Append a record to the tamper-evident decision-audit chain (kind 2). Needs the enterprise tier.
tools.name: fractal_audit_log

tools.description: Decode a persisted audit blob (hex) into its JSON.
tools.name: fractal_audit_unpack

tools.description: Enterprise: several mutually different near-optimal portfolios.
tools.name: fractal_optimize_portfolio_multimodal

tools.description: Enterprise: the non-dominated return-versus-risk front.
tools.name: fractal_optimize_portfolio_multimodal_pareto

tools.description: Store rows as a corpus: packs the rows as float32 into one key so fractal_search and the agents can use it. Honours FSQL_MCP_KEY_PREFIX.
tools.name: fractal_store_vectors

tools.description: Store a numeric series as packed float32 under a key, for the series tools and agents. Honours FSQL_MCP_KEY_PREFIX.
tools.name: fractal_store_series

tools.description: Write a hash: the IDS / CONTENT / FILTER companions the agents read (field = row index). Honours FSQL_MCP_KEY_PREFIX.
tools.name: fractal_store_hash

tools.description: Delete a key (a corpus, series or hash this server wrote). Honours FSQL_MCP_KEY_PREFIX.
tools.name: fractal_delete_key

tools.description: Describe a key: its type and, for a corpus or series, how many float32 values it holds.
tools.name: fractal_key_info

tools.description: The module's version and edition, the Valkey server version and this MCP server's version.
tools.name: fractal_version
